findings: Two earlier Level 2 evidence artifacts recorded stale package-wide test counts and a stale Skill line count, and treated a qualitative forward-test record as an executed verification command.
The new supporting_artifacts path validation lacked direct regression coverage for absolute paths, parent traversal, missing files, duplicate IDs, and unsupported kinds.
The delivery-lifecycle forward-test record was not yet referenced by a hash-verified evidence artifact.
remediation: Removed qualitative forward-test records from verification commands, retained them only as supporting artifacts, and updated package-wide verification claims after the final suite run.
Added deterministic regression tests for each reviewed supporting_artifacts validation boundary.
Attached the delivery-lifecycle forward-test to the new delivery-lifecycle-repository-hygiene Level 2 evidence artifact with its SHA-256 digest.
final_note: A fresh Codex native code-reviewer re-review found no remaining issues after confirming the executed-verification boundary and all five supporting-artifact validation cases. The final Level 2 evidence artifact is intentionally created only after this approval so it can cite a truthful outcome.
